const values: (string | number | null)[] = [1, "a", null, "b", 2];

const named = values.filter((x) => {
  const isText = typeof x === "string";
  return isText;
});
console.log(named.map((text) => text.toUpperCase()).join(","));

const logged = values.filter((x) => {
  console.log("check", x);
  return typeof x === "number";
});
console.log(logged.map((n) => n.toFixed(1)).join(","));

const present = values.filter(function (x) {
  const label = String(x);
  console.log(label.length);
  return x !== null;
});
console.log(present.map((value) => value.toString()).join(","));

const filled: (string | number | null)[] = ["c", 4];
const guarded = filled.filter((x) => {
  if (x !== null) {
    return typeof x === "string";
  }
  throw new Error("null value");
});
console.log(guarded.map((text) => text.toUpperCase()).join(","));

const narrowed = filled.filter((x) => {
  if (x === null) throw new Error("null value");
  return typeof x === "number";
});
console.log(narrowed.map((n) => n * 2).join(","));

const finished = [1, "z", 3].filter((x) => {
  try {
    return typeof x === "number";
  } finally {
    console.log("done", x);
  }
});
console.log(finished.reduce((sum, n) => sum + n, 0));
